primary_sources.title: A subexponential-time quantum algorithm for the dihedral hidden subgroup problem
primary_sources.author: Greg Kuperberg
primary_sources.inspected: Section3 labelled phase qubits and measured CNOT sum/difference; Theorem7.1 and Section7 arbitrary finite abelian direct products and labelled phase-source interface.
primary_sources.supports: known ideal time/query form 2^{O(sqrt(log|A|))} for the generalized-dihedral phase source
primary_sources.does_not_supply: The repository's physical noisy preparation, polynomial growing-depth recovery, a robust decoder, finite fitted constants or free desired branch signs.
